name: List All Property Groups
description: Returns all property groups that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the property group. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter property groups last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property group

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the property group's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the property group

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyIds
responseFields.description: Array of PropertyIds linked to the property group. Hidden properties within a property group are returned by default. Polling for a PropertyId that is hidden will return no data. Note: To associate hidden properties yielded from this endpoint with those from the Properties endpoint, ensure the IncludeHidden filter is enabled.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
